'''Kintoni''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained a single city with several towns, the rest being farmland. It contained [[Tinegris Street]]. [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces occupied a former Imperial [[Kintoni garrison|garrison]] on Kintoni circa [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], where [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Barkale]] was held prisoner. [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] [[Mission to Kintoni|infiltrated]] the base and assassinated Barkale on the behalf of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] for stealing [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] over the past ten years.
